description: This source file contains unit tests for the FileBasedCredentialsService class in the org.eclipse.hono.deviceregistry package, verifying file operations, startup behavior, credential loading and saving, and update restrictions.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FileBasedCredentialsService, testing file operations, startup scenarios, credential persistence, and access controls.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and service objects before each test.

methods.name: testDoStartCreatesFile
methods.description: Verifies that the service creates credential files if they do not exist during startup.

methods.name: testDoStartFailsIfFileCannotBeCreated
methods.description: Verifies that startup fails if credentials file cannot be created.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoresMalformedJson
methods.description: Ensures startup proceeds even if credential or registration files contain malformed JSON.

methods.name: testDoStartLoadsCredentials
methods.description: Checks that credentials are loaded from file during startup.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoreCredentialIfStartEmptyIsSet
methods.description: Ensures credentials are ignored during startup if startEmpty is configured.

methods.name: testLoadCredentialsCanReadOutputOfSaveToFile
methods.description: Validates that credentials saved to file can be read back and reloaded correctly.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Tests that credential updates are rejected if modification is disabled.
